subject: Medford Community Housing Loan Issues
overview: The board received updates on unrecorded loan documents involving Medford Community Housing and discussed an equity buy-down research model and fractional payment metrics. The board also voted to approve several past meeting minutes and to recess its regular June meeting unless pressing business arises.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved minutes from the April 1 board meeting as well as the March 30, April 15, and April 28 fundraising working group meetings.

items.title: Medford Community Housing Update
items.summary: Staff reported that original loan documents signed with Medford Community Housing were never recorded at the Registry of Deeds by former representative Andrew Rapa, prompting board discussion regarding legal remedies and conditions before executing an additional $100,000 loan.

items.title: Planning, Development and Sustainability Open House Debrief
items.summary: Staff summarized community engagement and public voting on housing priorities from the April 13 municipal open house.

items.title: Fundraising Working Group Updates
items.summary: Staff suggested moving the proposed community housing fair and fundraiser to the fall to allow more planning time and reported progress on setting up an online donation page.

items.title: Equity Buy-Down Program Research
items.summary: Intern Juliette presented research based on a Springfield model exploring how trust funds could bridge the gap between market rates and deed-restricted affordable housing prices.

items.title: Fractional Payment Presentation Update
items.summary: Staff reported that City Council referred proposed zoning language for fractional payments to the Community Development Board, but noted the formula needs revisions because the state is no longer updating the Qualified Allocation Plan metric.

items.title: Financial Updates
items.summary: Staff noted that funds have not yet been moved into the new trust account and an updated financial spreadsheet will be presented at the next meeting.

items.title: Board Term Expirations
items.summary: Staff notified members that three seats expire on July 1, and Mayor Lungo-Koehn clarified that members may continue serving until reappointed or replaced.

items.title: Status Updates and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The board thanked departing intern Juliette and voted to recess the regular June meeting unless urgent business requires staff to convene the trustees.
